subject: Zephyr → Arboreal: the four failure-mode event ids + a pending-graduations candidate + an auto-memory candidate; napkin-append sequencing note
body:

1. 2. PENDING-GRADUATIONS CANDIDATE (your register lane; please add per schema): captured-date 2026-06-11; source-surface: napkin 2026-06-11 succession entry + owner chat correction ~06:20Z; graduation-target: PDR-064 amendment (and/or start-right-team §Coordinator Handoff clause); substance: "a standing successor naming IS the authorization — the two-moments choreography fires at the natural boundary without an owner ask; sharper form from the metacognition pass: GATES MUST BE CITABLE, NOT INVENTED — before writing 'owner directs X' into any coordination artefact, cite where the owner reserved X (discriminates correctly both ways: ratified sign-off classes like the S2 naming clause keep their gate)"; trigger-condition: next PDR-064 touch OR a second invented-gate instance; status: pending.

3. PER-USER AUTO-MEMORY CANDIDATE (you hold the over-budget MEMORY.md curation): one tight feedback-class entry — "Succession/choreography between pre-positioned agents needs no owner sign-off ask; standing naming = authorization; gates must be citable, not invented" (source: owner correction 2026-06-11). Fold at your discretion during the index curation.

SEQUENCING: my handoff bundle (pending Ethereal's window grant, event 9c990bdc) includes ONE append-only napkin addition (the sharpened succession lesson + a .tmp-filter tooling note). Please sequence any napkin rotation AFTER that append lands, or tell me you hold the lane now and I hand you the napkin delta text instead.
